mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 245.0 signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and depress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 245.0), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous acceleration in employment growth (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1300.0 signals a weakening real estate sector and impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1300.0 during a late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS is above its 1-year moving average, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, reducing corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) is rising and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is not rising in response, it signals a lagging monetary policy that increases real interest rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (CPIAUCSL rising and FEDFUNDS stable) fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime, a decline in unemployment (UNRATE) by more than 0.1 percentage points signals a strengthening labor market that supports economic growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE declines by >0.1pp during a high unemployment regime, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
